dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: The skill provides many concrete thresholds (CPU <30%, FreeableMemory >50%, idle detection 0 connections for 7+ days, exact cost multipliers for Multi-AZ, gp3 IOPS baseline, io2 pricing, Graviton cost advantage, RI discount percentages, ACU cost model). However, most of these figures are publicly documented and a capable model could already retrieve them; the skill does not introduce a novel decision matrix or proprietary heuristic, so the delta is solid but not maximal.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: The procedure is AWS‑specific (CLI commands, pre‑flight checks, ordering of dimensions, right‑sizing decision tree, RI purchase flow). Some steps are generic (e.g., "monitor for 7 days" or "verify with application team") and lack AWS‑unique nuance, preventing a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: A thorough NEVER list is present with concrete reasons (e.g., never recommend Compute Savings Plans for RDS, never downsize without FreeableMemory, never use Graviton for Oracle/SQL Server). One minor shortfall: the rationale for the Graviton restriction is only "engine compatibility" without explicitly stating the lack of binary support, leaving a tiny gap.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete, description, when‑to‑use, activation triggers, and invocation schema are all present. The activation trigger list is overly exhaustive, which could cause false activations, and the "when to invoke" description could be tighter, so a small deduction applies.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The skill layers information (quick reference, mindset, philosophy, pre‑flight, process, decision tree, error handling) but the initial sections are dense and front‑load many details before the core decision tree, creating cognitive overload for an agent that needs the concise top‑level rule set first.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated by CONFIRM and snapshot steps, showing good calibration. However, pricing‑model recommendations allow RI purchase without checking account limits or existing RI coverage, and storage‑autoscaling recommendations lack constraints on max‑size reductions, leaving a slight over‑freedom.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: The skill follows a recognizable structure (metadata, description, mindset, philosophy, process, decision tree, anti‑patterns, error handling). The inclusion of many disparate sections (e.g., recent AWS features, detailed cost tables) makes the pattern a bit ad‑hoc rather than a clean, single template.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI snippets, decision trees, savings formulas, and error‑handling tables, enabling an agent to act. Missing handling of read‑replica downsize sequencing in the main flow and occasional inconsistencies in the example savings calculations (e.g., rounding mismatches) prevent a perfect score.
